messages:
maria: Hey team — starting onboarding for equinox-14b. Quick checks: where are the model weights, and does this one need a special CUDA/Triton/kernel combo? Also noticed tokenizer intermittently drops a leading space on a few prompts, want to flag early.

sam: We have weights at s3://redwood-models/equinox/equinox-14b/v1.0/weights.tar.lz4. Tokenizer is HF style but BOS token id is 2 (not the usual 1) — make sure the wrapper sets bos_token_id=2. Config.json shows max_seq_len: 8192 (runtime default 4096) so we need to validate memory planning.

ashley: Kernel note: this model benefits from the amp-attn-v2 kernel for large KV workloads. That kernel requires CUDA >=12.6 and Triton runtime 2.3+. On our nodes running CUDA 12.4 it'll fall back to the generic kernel and you'll see memory/latency spikes.

josh: FYI the current base image on master is cuda:12.4-cudnn8. I'll open a PR to bump base to cuda12.6 and rebuild images.

maria: thanks — @josh can you also check libstdc++ / glibc ABI? We hit a mismatch last month when we bumped kernels.

ci-bot: Build queued: rebuild-images/342 started by josh. ETA ~30m. Logs: https://ci.redwood/1234

sam: Also watch padding behavior: our quick smoke showed the tokenizer emits repeated <|pad|> tokens when pad_token_id != 0 in the runtime config. Recommendation: set pad_token_id=0 in model config or edit tokenizer wrapper to map pad -> 0. Otherwise LM decoding may produce leading pads in completions.

ashley: For rollout strategy: prefer a canary in a pinned nodepool with kernel pinning (amp-attn-v2). If the kernel fallback triggers, we should auto-failover to the orion-7b variant to preserve latency SLOs. Can we add a fallback policy?

maria: Canary + fallback sounds good. @sam can you open the infra ticket with rollout details? I can schedule the canary for tomorrow 10:00 PST.

sam: Opening ticket now: https://tickets.redwood/INF-6721 — includes weights path, tokenizer note (BOS=2, pad mapping), runtime config changes (max_seq_len -> 8192), kernel pin request (amp-attn-v2), canary pool = eqx-canary (2xA100-80G), fallback = orion-7b.

josh: CI PR merged, container rebuilt to redwood/runtime:cuda12.6-20260316 and pushed. I added a libstdc++ compatibility symlink to avoid the ABI break we saw. Image digest: sha256:abcd1234.

maria: Added to INF-6721: request code review on runtime/model config PR and unit tests for tokenizer wrapper. Tagging reviewers @ashley @sam.

ashley: Reviewing now, left a minor comment about explicit pad-token unit test. :thumbsup:

sam: lgtm from infra side. If no objections I'll start the canary tomorrow at 10:00 PST.

ci-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for 2026-03-18 10:00:00 PST. Canary job id: canary-8891

maria: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll monitor eval diffs and token-level costs during canary and post updates here.
